newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures ease following APIs.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures ease following APIs.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy futures prices softened in overnight Wednesday trade, following a weekly inventory report from the American Petroleum Institute (API), which showed increases in crude supplies.
During after-hours trade, March crude fell 16 cents a barrel to $22.63, amid volume of 1,312 lots traded.
Supplies of crude seemed ample as a 7.05-million-barrel build in Gulf Coast crude levels outweighed a four million barrel decline on the West Coast, according to the API.
"With these numbers, you'll see (crude) come off a bit," Thursday, one broker said.
Front-month gasoline futures eased 0.33 cents a gallon to 64.35 cents a gallon amid light volume 13 lots traded.
March heating oil decreased 0.44 cents a gallon to 59.15 cents a gallon, amid volume of 87 lots in March and 151 overall.
